subject: Argentum Systems — Security intake & CAIQ/SIG scheduling
messages:
From: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@argentum.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@argentum.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Quick intro + SIG/CAIQ intake for Argentum

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for taking this. We’re kicking off a SIG/CAIQ intake as part of our vendor review for Q3. I wanted to check availability for a short intake call (30–45 min) next week to walk through a few items:

- High-level deployment model and data residency options
- Logging/retention (sample log types we can request)
- Access controls (SSO/KMS/HSM questions)
- Any current CAIQ/SIG artifacts you can share ahead of time

We’ve attached our preliminary spreadsheet with a few high-priority items (Argentum_SIG_v1.xlsx). Preferable times for our security team are Tue/Wed morning (ET). If that doesn’t work, we can be flexible. Also: do you have a contact for logging samples and for encryption key custody?

Look forward to coordinating.

—Maria
Security Ops, Argentum Systems
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@argentum.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick intro + SIG/CAIQ intake for Argentum

Hi Maria — great to meet you via email. Thanks for sending the spreadsheet. Marissa (security intake lead) and Ben (platform engineer) are on this thread; we’ll run the intake and follow up with artifacts.

Availability: We can do
- Tue 22 Jun, 10:30–11:15 ET
- Wed 23 Jun, 09:00–09:45 ET

If either works, send a calendar invite and we’ll confirm.

Pre-call asks (to make the meeting most productive):
- Any particularly high-risk controls you want us to prioritize in the SIG (e.g., egress controls, client-side encryption)
- A short list of systems / integrations that will touch PHI/PII (if applicable)
- Desired artifacts: full CAIQ or a targeted export? We can share a redacted CAIQ draft and a SIG mapping in advance.

Owners: Ben will handle log-sampling questions and can share what logs we can provide (access/redaction constraints). Marissa will coordinate the CAIQ response and evidence handoff.

Attachments we’ll prepare ahead of the call: redwood-caiq-draft.pdf, sample log manifest.

Thanks,
Jordan
Director, Compliance Solutions
Redwood Inference
From: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@argentum.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: security@argentum.com
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Quick intro + SIG/CAIQ intake for Argentum

Jordan — thanks, Wed 23 Jun 09:00 ET works for us. I’ve sent a calendar invite to that slot and included our security lead (security@argentum.com). We’ll prioritize egress controls and encryption (client-side) for the meeting.

We attached the SIG sheet with notes on the highest-priority items. If you can send the CAIQ draft and a summary of what logs are available prior to the call, that will help our SME review.

Also: our procurement team may join the call for a short pricing/contract question near the end — I’ll flag in the agenda if that happens.

See you on the 23rd,
Maria
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Maria Sanchez <maria.sanchez@argentum.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 11:37:00 -0700
Subject: Argentum intake — meeting notes + action items (23 Jun call prep)

Hi Maria — thanks again for scheduling. Quick summary and pre-read links before Wed’s call (09:00 ET):

What we shared (attached):
- redwood-caiq-draft.pdf — our redacted CAIQ draft (covers common controls, hosting, and encryption).
- sample-log-manifest.csv (referenced in meeting) — short manifest listing feasible log exports (auth, proxy, inference request audit, admin actions).

Pre-call notes / context:
- Egress controls: We support per-tenant egress ACLs and VPC SCOPES for private deployments. Ben will show a short diagram and examples during the call.
- Encryption: Redwood supports customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) in Dedicated and Private; client-side encryption patterns are possible but require an integration plan.
- Logs: We can provide redacted request/response metadata and auth logs. Raw inference payloads are considered sensitive; we can provide sampling options and an extraction runbook.

Action items before the call (owners):
- Marissa: upload CAIQ draft to shared Drive and add a one-pager mapping to Argentum_SIG_v1.xlsx (due Mon 21 Jun).
- Ben: prepare a short log-sample manifest and diagram of encryption options (due Tue 22 Jun).
- Maria / Argentum: send list of priority controls and any compliance timelines you’re operating on (e.g., audit windows) so we can focus answers.

Attachments: Argentum_SIG_v1.xlsx (from you), redwood-caiq-draft.pdf, sample-log-manifest.csv (attached to this thread). Meeting recording and full notes will be posted to the Drive link afterward.

If anything changes to attendees/time, please let us know. Looking forward to a focused conversation on Wed.

—Jordan
